assumptions: STL uses millimetres; the supplied assembly-from-lidar transform translation uses metres.
Display axes: +X = assembly -Z, +Y = assembly +X, +Z = assembly -Y; vehicle forward is a visual CAD assumption.
Display origin is the horizontal mesh bounding-box centre at its lowest plane, not ROS base_link or measured ground.
LiDAR origin is the supplied geometry bounding-box centre, not a calibrated optical measurement origin.
Uncalibrated axis assumption: livox +X -> lidar CAD +Z, livox +Y -> lidar CAD +X, livox +Z -> lidar CAD +Y. Gravity cannot establish yaw.
Rotation starts from the CAD installation and assumed axes, then minimally aligns the saved stationary IMU acceleration to display +Z. Vehicle mesh stays horizontal.
The saved stationary observation may include vehicle tilt; this is a display estimate only. No TF, ROS data, driver extrinsics or recordings are changed.
